title: OnabotulinumtoxinA as Treatment for Major Depressive Disorder in Adult Females
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the safety and efficacy of onabotulinumtoxinA (BOTOX®) compared with placebo as treatment for major depressive disorder (MDD) in adult females.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Moderate to severe major depressive disorder

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior treatment with botulinum toxin of any serotype for any reason
* Use of antidepressant medication for depression within 2 weeks of study
* Diagnosis of Myasthenia gravis, Eaton-Lambert Syndrome, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
